_comments: API SCOPES FOR THE ACCOUNTING REMOTE OPERATIONS (#310). Every Accounting operation declares RequiredScope
accounting:read, accounting:write or accounting:post (metadata/remote-operations for the generated ones, the class
itself for the code-only ones). Without these rows MJAPI refuses every API-key call to them on a host that installs
A parent `accounting` with read, write and post children, matching how MJ lays out its own scopes. `post` is apart
from `write` (#329) so a key that creates journal entries or raises finance exceptions cannot also send batches to
the ERP; scopes match exactly, so `write` does not include `post` and `post` does not include `write`. The application
ceiling that allows them on MJAPI is in metadata/api-application-scopes. A host then only issues API keys.

fields.Name: accounting
fields.Description: Parent scope for Accounting remote operations

fields.Name: read
fields.Description: Read-only Accounting operations: batch previews, journal entry states, stranded entries, approval state and finance exception types

fields.Name: write
fields.Description: Accounting operations that change data inside Accounting: journal entries and reversals, batch build, regenerate, decisions, archive and cancellation, and finance exceptions

fields.Name: post
fields.Description: Accounting operations that act on the ERP: dispatch a batch to the ERP, finish posting a batch the ERP accepted, and run the ERP master-data sync
